description: The GSI tile catalogue lists base maps, aerial imagery, terrain, land-use and hazard-related map layers. It distinguishes GSI survey products and third-party layers and provides separate reuse conditions for different categories. The resource is documented by Geospatial Information Authority of Japan. The verified page defines the resource scope; exact spatial resolution, time span and update frequency are not established by this review. The documentation is publicly accessible. Licence: GSI content-use terms with layer-specific and third-party conditions. Charges are unconfirmed and require provider clarification. Some survey-product uses require permission; real-time tile display has a specified attribution route. Check each layer, not applying one licence to the whole collection. The resource can support infrastructure modelling; suitability for a specific simulation requires checking its inputs and assumptions. No directly related catalogue record was established; no compatibility is implied. Only metadata were checked; numerical accuracy and current service availability remain unverified.
